# State of the Art in Missingness-Aware Learning {#sec-background}

* Multivariate Imputation by Chained Equations and its variants
* Ensemble methods - HyperImpute, RF-GAP
* Modern deep learning-based / generative supervised imputation methods - GAIN, MIRACLE, ReMasker, etc.
* Imputation in time-series: LOCF, CSDI, DISK, etc.
* kNN imputation: History and controversies (IQ and the Wealth of Nations, 2005)
* (Morvan and Varoquaux, 2025) - why better imputation doesn't necessarily imply better downstream task performance.
* Models for joint imputation-downstream task: NeuMiss, GRAPE, etc. (Relate to [Chapter -@sec-knnTheory])
* Models that perform downstream tasks without imputation - FLDA (Relate to [Chapter -@sec-mudra])
* Models that perform imputation in more complex structures, eg. graphs (Relate to [Chapter -@sec-fuse])

One of the earliest major advancements in multivariate imputation was by @mice.
